title: Backend Engineer
job_description: We are hiring a Backend Engineer (Python) to build and operate the services behind our recruitment-automation platform: FastAPI services, data-processing pipelines, document parsing, and LLM-based evaluation. Strong Python, REST/API design, testing (pytest) and CI experience expected; PDF/document processing and LLM integration are a plus.

title: Graphic Designer
job_description: We are hiring a Graphic/Product Designer to own visual and brand design across our product and marketing surfaces. We care about visual hierarchy, layout, and craft; fluency with Figma/Adobe tooling; a strong portfolio; and close collaboration with product and engineering. The CV itself is treated as a design artifact.
